objections.text: The single hand-derived case already supplies SupplierReference '' and NULL on separate suppliers and a NULL DeliveryMethodID, then compares all projected values. A01 repeats those exact NULL-versus-empty and LEFT JOIN mechanisms.
objections.resolution: A01 now contrasts an empty name from an existing delivery-method row with NULL from a nullable DeliveryMethodID in the same output column, and reverses the SupplierReference NULL-empty arrangement. This adds a join-produced NULL versus stored-empty attack.

objections.text: The hand-derived case already keeps a supplier whose category, both contacts and city point to missing rows, and its supplier rows already share the default fax number. A02 repeats both the LEFT JOIN and non-key-tie conditions.
objections.resolution: A02 now uses valid nullable DeliveryMethodID only, crosses primary and alternate contacts to expose a wrong self-join, and ties phone, fax, and website values. It no longer repeats dangling required references.
